description: This file contains implementations of symbolic tensor operations for torch, specifically functions related to 'torch.sym*' ops implemented with ONNX scripting. It defines various trace-only symbolic functions such as sym_float, sym_max, sym_min, sym_not, sym_sum, and sym_ite, which leverage ONNX operators to perform tensor computations.

methods.name: FLOAT sym_float(self: TensorType)
methods.description: Converts a symbolic float tensor to a symbolic float type using ONNX cast operation.

methods.name: IntType sym_max(x: IntType, y: IntType)
methods.description: Returns the element-wise maximum of two symbolic integer tensors using ONNX Max operation.

methods.name: IntType sym_min(x: IntType, y: IntType)
methods.description: Returns the element-wise minimum of two symbolic integer tensors using ONNX Min operation.

methods.name: BOOL sym_not(self: BOOL)
methods.description: Performs logical NOT on a symbolic boolean tensor.

methods.name: IntType sym_sum(args: Sequence[IntType])
methods.description: Computes the sum of a sequence of symbolic integers, returning a symbolic integer, using repeated ONNX Add operations.

methods.name: TTensor sym_ite(b: BOOL, t: TTensor, f: TTensor)
methods.description: Emulates a tensor if-then-else operation with a symbolic boolean condition, returning one of two tensors.

ctags.name: sym_ite
ctags.pattern: /^def sym_ite(b: BOOL, t: TTensor, f: TTensor) -> TTensor:$/
